SOLO ARTIST / K-POP

AleXa

INSTAGRAM ↗YOUTUBE ↗

AleXa made her solo debut with “Bomb” in 2019 and won American Song Contest with “Wonderland” in 2022. The English-language “Juliet” turns toward intimate storytelling and a more vulnerable vocal performance, with Korean and Spanish versions extending the song into different settings.
